beaches.name: Matira Beach, Bora Bora
beaches.description: A crescent of pale sand fringed by turquoise lagoon water, with Mount Otemanu rising in the distance. Best visited at low tide when the sandbar stretches far into the sea.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A four-kilometre arc of Rio's most famous shoreline, backed by mosaic promenades and mountain views. Arrive early for a quiet swim before the beach volleyball games begin.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument in the world, its five lotus-bud towers reflected in surrounding moats at sunrise. Wear covered shoulders and knees to enter the inner sanctuary.

temples.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha, Kyoto
temples.description: Thousands of vermilion torii gates climb the wooded slopes of Mount Inari, each donated by a business seeking prosperity. The full loop takes about two hours on foot.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.description: Home to the sail-shaped Opera House and the harbour bridge climb, with sandstone cliffs and surf beaches just a short train ride from downtown.

cities.name: Cairns
cities.description: The gateway to the Great Barrier Reef, where rainforest meets coral sea. Day boats depart daily for snorkelling and diving among the outer reefs.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: A city of neon crossings and quiet backstreet shrines, where centuries-old tea houses sit beside some of the tallest towers in Asia.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.description: Japan's former imperial capital, with over a thousand temples, preserved geisha districts, and cherry blossoms lining the Philosopher's Path each spring.

cities.name: Cusco
cities.description: The former capital of the Inca Empire, built atop stone foundations so precise a blade cannot slip between the blocks. The launch point for treks to Machu Picchu.

cities.name: Lima
cities.description: A coastal capital famous for its ceviche and clifftop parks overlooking the Pacific, where paragliders drift above the Miraflores boardwalk each evening.
